content: This CrewAI run failed at the validation and repository publish stages due to missing prerequisite artifacts: the requirements document, generated components, and configuration files from earlier pipeline stages were not present. READY_FOR_PUBLISH was never achieved. No files or repository updates occurred. Key learning: enforce output presence checks at each pipeline stage and improve failure signaling upstream. This record allows future runs to identify repeating failure points and adjust CrewAI production workflows accordingly.
